CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

2. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.

3. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

4. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

5. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   C. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.

6. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.

7. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Football.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Football.

8. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.
   B. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.

9. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

10. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

12. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.

13. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

14. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   B. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   D. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.

15. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts Works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The suggest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Wind Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Football and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
